claims.text: The original North Inlet candidate identifier does not match the published sampling station.
The legacy mechanism model did not beat elevation and developed share.
The lagged water and season baseline failed to improve on development-selected persistence in 15 final storms. No predictive upgrade is established.
North mean absolute log1p(FNU) error was 6.84% lower on the distinct six-hour test. Monitoring superiority was not established and East transfer failed.
The supplementary Glenwood classifier found two more high windows using two more proposed slots; its frozen joint business criteria failed.

independent_method_review: Storm windows were selected retrospectively from rainfall. Their start can precede the qualifying 2 mm in 6 h trigger by up to 22.83 h; this is not a validated issued forecast.
The 24 h dry-gap event rule makes all 28 antecedent 24 h rain features zero. The fitted B1 comparison therefore varies with lagged discharge and season.
One eligible window has 900 s native cadence; 27 have 600 s cadence. Sensor-change quality control remains unverified.
